name: Evil Women
overview: The Scriptures warn against the destructive influence of evil women, portraying them as those who harbor mischief and cause conflict (Psalms 140:2). Their ways are unstable and difficult to discern, leading others away from the path of life (Proverbs 5:6). Adultery with such women is a sign of folly that destroys the soul (Proverbs 6:32), and external beauty without discretion is likened to a precious jewel in an inappropriate setting (Proverbs 11:22). The Bible further compares a contentious and angry woman to persistent, bothersome rain, emphasizing the hardship of living with such a disposition (Proverbs 21:19; 27:15).
